messages:
maya (Marketing): Heads-up: aiming to send the soft release announcement for Dedicated v0.9.3 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog, live docs link, webinar time, and a short bench blurb by EOD. Can we hit that?
dev (Engineering): We can hit it if docs go live by 18:00 PT. Changelog ready to paste. No API breaks.
maya (Marketing): Paste the changelog bullets here 1. Keep bullets customer-facing.
dev (Engineering): Changelog top lines:
- KV prefix reuse: ~18% median token cost reduction for chat-heavy workloads
- Smart routing now supports fallback to compatible smaller variants
- New runtime flag: `routing.canary_percent` for staged rollouts
- Deprecations: `model-alpha` -> mapped to `rwdl-v1-compat` (migration guide in docs)
tess (Growth): Webinar ask: 30 min demo + 10 min Q&A. Best slot to hit EU & US is 11:00 PT. Need recording + 1-slide bench summary.
nora (Product): 11:00 PT ok but avoid 15:00-18:00 PT support window for canary promotion. Also prefer canary start the night before for low-traffic validation.
kevin (Docs): I'll publish the release page and migration guide. Link will be https://docs.redwood.com/releases/dedicated-v0.9.3. Target publish 17:45 PT and I'll post the live URL here.
maya (Marketing): Social copy drafts (please pick / tweak):
```
Option A: Dedicated v0.9.3 - lower inference costs and smarter routing. Up to 18% median token savings for chat apps. Learn more + register for the webinar.
Option B: Ship faster, pay less: Dedicated v0.9.3 introduces KV cache reuse and routing fallbacks that lower token costs by ~18%. Join our demo.```
kevin (Docs): Migration snippet I'll add:
```
# map old names in config
model_map = {
  "model-alpha": "rwdl-v1-compat",
}
```
dev (Engineering): Rollout plan: canary 5% for 3 hours, 25% for 6 hours, then 100%. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.2% or latency p95 resize >25%. Also we'll block promotion during support window.
nora (Product): Agreed. Add a health-check baseline snapshot and an automatic rollback if any customer-side 5xx surge detected.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: dedicated-v0.9.3 canary @2335040000 (placeholder).
tess (Growth): I've asked Sales for a beta customer quote. If we get it, we can lead the email with a short testimonial. Also will create a 1-slide benchmark graphic from the 18% number.
maya (Marketing): Final checklist here: 1) Changelog posted in this thread, 2) Docs live URL, 3) Webinar scheduled (slot + link), 4) Bench blurb + social copy, 5) Deploy plan + canary gating. Reply here as you close items. :thumbsup:
kevin (Docs): Published: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/dedicated-v0.9.3 (live) - migration section added.
dev (Engineering): Deploy config pushed, gating flags added to infra repo. Pasting canary config snippet: `routing.canary_percent=5; gating.error_threshold=1.2`
maya (Marketing): Great work. If Sales provides the quote, I'll finalize the email subject A/B and schedule the soft announce. Thank you all.
